subtitle: UPDATE July 24, 17:31 BRT, at 72 days until the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). Second consecutive day without a new national voting-intention poll: [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) (Tier 1) was registered with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) for today (BR-01166/2026, n=2,004, fieldwork July 22-24) and was NOT released before the market capture, so no number of theirs enters here and the most recent polling remains the Gerp of July 22. The move of the day was Lula's, who broke through 61% for the first time since July 15 and closed the capture at 61.50% (up 1.00pp), while Flávio remained virtually flat at 22.95% (up 0.10pp). The gap rose to +38.55pp, the largest since July 9 (38.60pp) and still below the cycle peak of +39.5pp (July 3). Unlike yesterday, when the gap widened through a fall by the challenger, today it widened through a rise by the frontrunner. Renan was almost flat in the winner market (11.75%, down 0.10pp), but lost 6.00pp in second place in the first round, from 17.40% to 11.40%, with Flávio recovering 3.50pp there (74.00%). In the field, only Zema rose, more than doubling to 0.95%; Caiado retreated to 1.75% and Michelle to 0.85%. In the Senate by seats the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) fell 3.50pp, to 68.50%, in the week when the Progressive Union federation settled its neutrality in the presidential race, decided on July 22, and on the day it emerged that the Lula administration had worked to produce that result (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, July 24), with the caveat that this book adds up to only USD 292 thousand in volume. Cross-referenced with live [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) July 24, 20:31 UTC.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) 61.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.63M accumulated), at 72 days until the election. Broke through 61% for the first time since July 15. The gap over Flávio rose to +38.55pp, the largest since July 9 (38.60pp) and below the cycle peak (+39.5pp on July 3).
fortes: He left the range he was locked in: 61.50% after three days flat at 60.50%, and it is his highest value since July 15.
Unlike yesterday, the gap widened through a rise of his own and not through a fall by the challenger. He gained 1.00pp while Flávio stayed virtually flat.
The gap of +38.55pp is the largest since July 9, when it marked 38.60pp, and it recovered almost all of the convergence of the previous three weeks.

The political maneuvering showed up in writing: reports on July 24 revealed the administration acting directly to pull the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) away from Flávio, an effort that produced the neutrality of the Progressive Union federation, decided on July 22 (G1, Folha de S.Paulo).
In the most recent polling, the Gerp of July 22, even being the pro-Flávio outlier house, he beats Caiado (44x41), Zema (44x38) and Renan (45x35), losing only the head-to-head runoff by 1pp.
The strongest Tier 1 consensus in the sample remains the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of July 15 (n=2,004, in person, reliability 5), which gave him +12pp in the first round and +8pp in the second.
fracos: The rise has no triggering event identified at the time: it is market momentum, not a declared reaction to a new fact, and a movement without a documented cause unwinds as easily as it came.
The level gap persists: 61.50% of implied probability against polls ranging from +12pp ([Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) July 15) to a disadvantage in the head-to-head runoff (Gerp July 22).

The polling test scheduled for today did not happen. [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) stayed registered and unreleased, so the panel enters the weekend with the latest reading coming from an outlier house.
Approval improved but did not turn: PoderData July 22 still puts the administration at 43% approve against 51% disapprove.
Dispersion among institutes remains high: in the first round the recent ones range from a 38x38 tie (Gerp) to Lula +12pp (Quaest), which keeps uncertainty about the real size of the lead.
Rejection high and stable in the last three national polls: 47% at Gerp, 49% at Indexa, 48% at Real Time, always close to Flávio's.

The agenda in Congress remains stalled: more than 20 defeats in his third term (Poder360), provisional measures lapsed in July, and a credit package of R$ 145 billion outside the fiscal framework in an election year (Estadão).
candidates.analise: After three trading sessions motionless at 60.50%, Lula broke the range and closed the capture at 61.50% (up 1.00pp, vol USD 7.63M accumulated), his highest value since July 15. The difference relative to the two previous days is one of nature, not magnitude: yesterday the gap widened 2.10pp because Flávio fell, today it widened 0.90pp because Lula rose, with the challenger virtually flat. The gap reached +38.55pp, the largest since July 9, when it marked 38.60pp, and it remains below the cycle peak of +39.5pp on July 3. There is no triggering event identified at the time of the movement, so the correct reading is market momentum, and AFOS does not attribute the rise to any specific news. The test that was on the calendar did not come: [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) was registered with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) for publication today, with n=2,004 and fieldwork from July 22 to 24, and up to the capture what circulated were announcement stories, no results. The same yardstick applied yesterday to [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) applies here: registration is not publication, and no number enters before release. The most recent polling remains the Gerp of July 22, the pro-Flávio outlier house, which ties him in the first round (38x38) and puts him 1pp behind in the head-to-head runoff. On political ground the day was good for him: reports on July 24 showed that the administration acted directly to pull the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) away from Flávio, an effort that produced the neutrality of the Progressive Union federation, decided on July 22 (G1, Folha de S.Paulo). Conventions run until August 5, and the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) one is tomorrow, July 25.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) 22.95% (up 0.10pp, vol USD 7.64M accumulated), virtually flat after yesterday's tumble. In second place in the first round he recovered 3.50pp, from 70.50% to 74.00%, and Lula's gap over him rose to +38.55pp because the frontrunner moved, not because he fell again.
fortes: He stanched the decline: after losing 2.10pp on July 23, he stayed virtually flat at 22.95% (up 0.10pp).
He recovered 3.50pp in second place in the first round, to 74.00%, with Renan falling from 17.40% to 11.40% in the same market.

The reconciliation with Michelle Bolsonaro advanced: after the video apology on the afternoon of July 23 and her acceptance that same night, the two are expected to record a video together and she is expected to join the campaign (Folha de S.Paulo, Gazeta do Povo, Metrópoles, July 24).

Javier Milei landed in Brazil on July 24 and was invited to speak at the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention on July 25, when the candidacy will be made official (Folha de S.Paulo, CartaCapital, Metrópoles).
The most recent polling is still favorable to him: the Gerp of July 22 ties him with Lula in the first round (38x38) and puts him ahead in the head-to-head runoff (46x45).
His rejection at Gerp (46%) came in below Lula's (47%), the least negative reading of the sample for him.
fracos: The neutrality of the Progressive Union federation (PP and [União Brasil](/en/glossary#uniao-brasil)), decided on July 22, emerged on July 24 as the result of maneuvering by the Lula administration to pull the [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) away from him (G1, Folha de S.Paulo), and the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) is resisting without managing to reverse it (O Globo, July 24). The PL fell 3.50pp in the Senate seats book on the same date.
Settling the running mate runs up against precisely the lack of centrão support (UOL, July 24), and the PL convention is tomorrow, July 25, still without a name.

The inquiry authorized on July 23 by Mendonça gained scope: it will investigate corruption and money laundering and targets him, Eduardo Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro (Folha de S.Paulo, July 24). He denies improper advantage and maintains that the funds were private.

He raised his tone against the Federal Police, calling its director-general a [pau-mandado](/en/glossary#pau-mandado) of Lula (Gazeta do Povo, July 24), at a moment when he is the target of an inquiry by the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) itself.

His remark containing false data about the voting machines bothered diplomats, who see potential for an effect on the election, and Eduardo Bolsonaro again undermined the electoral system afterwards (Folha de S.Paulo, July 24).
He captured nothing of the recovery: his price stayed flat while Lula rose 1.00pp, and the gap returned to its highest level since July 9.
The two national polls of July 21 keep him at 30-33% in the first round and losing the second against Lula, a lower level than he has held before.
candidates.analise: Flávio stanched the decline without reversing anything. After losing 2.10pp on July 23, he stayed virtually flat today, at 22.95% (up 0.10pp, vol USD 7.64M accumulated), and Lula's gap over him rose anyway, to +38.55pp, because the one who moved was the frontrunner. The recovery showed up in one place only, the second-place-in-the-first-round sub-market, where he went back from 70.50% to 74.00%, up 3.50pp, with a direct counterpart in Renan, who fell from 17.40% to 11.40% there. In other words, the market gave him back the standing of likely opponent to Lula in the runoff, without giving back probability of victory. On political ground the day brought two good pieces of news and several bad ones. Good: the reconciliation with Michelle advanced to a joint video, after his apology and her acceptance on July 23, and Javier Milei landed in Brazil on July 24 to speak at the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) convention (Folha de S.Paulo, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital). Bad: reports on July 24 showed that the neutrality of the Progressive Union federation, decided on July 22, came out of maneuvering by the Lula administration, and the choice of running mate remains stalled by the same lack of [centrão](/en/glossary#centrao) support (G1, UOL), the inquiry authorized on July 23 appeared today with a scope of corruption and laundering targeting him, Eduardo and Vorcaro (Folha), and he called the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) director-general a [pau-mandado](/en/glossary#pau-mandado) of Lula (Gazeta do Povo). In the market, the PL fell 3.50pp in the Senate seats book, from 72.00% to 68.50%, with the mandatory caveat that this market has accumulated volume of USD 292 thousand, orders of magnitude below the presidential race. The PL convention is tomorrow, still without a running mate.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) 11.75% in the winner market (down 0.10pp, vol USD 8.45M accumulated), the second highest price in the book and the largest individual volume among the competitive names. The move of the day was in the sub-market: he fell 6.00pp in second place in the first round, from 17.40% to 11.40%, holding 67.00% in third place.
fortes: He sustained the recent level in the winner market: 11.75% after having come off the floor of 7.8% on July 17, an advance of almost 4pp in a little over a week.
He remains firm in third place in the first round, with 67.00%, a level that fell only 1.00pp even with the day's rearrangement.
He has the largest accumulated volume among the competitive names in the presidential book, USD 8.45M, above Lula (7.63M) and Flávio (7.64M).
One of the three recent national polls, Real Time of July 21, sustains 9% in the first round, showing that the price level is not impossible in polling, however isolated.
Ciro Gomes named him as a voting possibility, alongside Caiado, leaving Flávio out (Folha, Gazeta do Povo).
fracos: He lost 6.00pp in second place in the first round, from 17.40% to 11.40%, the largest decline on the panel for the date, while Flávio recovered 3.50pp in the same market.
Majority polling remains at 3%: Gerp July 22 and Indexa July 21 measure him at 3%, and only Real Time gave 9%. Nothing in polling changed, because no national poll came out.
The price of 11.75% remains above the highest polling reading of the cycle (Real Time's 9%), so there is no poll that sustains the current level.

The test that would decide the case did not come: [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) was registered for today (BR-01166/2026) and was not released before the capture, so the distortion enters the weekend without polling arbitration.
In the head-to-head runoff, Gerp has him losing to Lula 35 to 45, with no runoff competitiveness, the same as Real Time had indicated (44x35).
Measured against the full cycle series, today's level is not a maximum: he was already worth 17.9% on June 9 and 12.8% on July 1, and closed July 23 at 12.0%.
candidates.analise: The Renan case changed shape today, and it is worth separating what moved from what did not. In the winner market he stayed virtually flat, at 11.75% (down 0.10pp), and the distortion against polling remains exactly where it was: two of the three recent national polls measure him at 3%, the third at 9%, and the price is above all of them. What changed was the design of the bet. In the second-place-in-the-first-round sub-market he fell 6.00pp, from 17.40% to 11.40%, while Flávio recovered 3.50pp in the same market, and at the same time he held 67.00% in third place. In plain terms: the market reduced the hypothesis that he would replace Flávio in the runoff and kept him as a firm third-place finisher. It is an internal rearrangement, not a correction of the disconnect, and the difference matters because the main price barely moved. The test that would settle the question did not come. [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) was registered with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) for publication today, with fieldwork from July 22 to 24, and was not released before the market capture, so the distortion carries through the weekend with no new polling to arbitrate it. The series caveat this panel has adopted stands: measured across the whole cycle, 11.75% is not a maximum, because Renan was worth 17.9% on June 9 and 12.8% on July 1 before falling to the floor of 7.8% on July 17. What exists is a price with no polling backing, at a level that has already been reached and undone twice since June.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket): Caiado 1.75% (down 0.30pp, vol USD 5.11M), Zema 0.95% (up 0.50pp, vol USD 4.52M), Michelle 0.85% (down 0.10pp, vol USD 9.23M), Haddad 0.35% (flat, vol USD 6.33M). Only Zema rose, and more than doubled in price. No new polling to explain the movement.
candidates.subtitle: July 24, at 72 days: second consecutive day without a national poll, with [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) registered for today and not released before the capture. Zema more than doubled, from 0.45% to 0.95%; Caiado gave back yesterday's gain and returned to 1.75%; Michelle retreated to 0.85% and Haddad stayed flat at 0.35%. The polling reference remains Gerp 3% (July 22), Indexa 6% and Real Time 7% (July 21), with Gerp putting Lula ahead in the head-to-head runoff (44x41). Conventions run until August 5, and the [PL](/en/glossary#pl) one is tomorrow.

caiado.label: CAIADO ([PSD](/en/glossary#psd)), presidential Poly 1.75% (down 0.30pp, vol USD 5.11M) | third place in the first round 16.00% (down 0.50pp) | Gerp July 22 R1 3% and runoff Lula 44% x Caiado 41% | Indexa July 21 R1 6% | Real Time July 21 R1 7% and runoff 43x44
caiado.fortes: He marked 6-7% in the two national polls of July 21 (Indexa 6, Real Time 7), double the 3-4% he had been running at, and he keeps the pure [PSD](/en/glossary#psd) ticket (Kassab as running mate) with a base in Goiás. He campaigned directly against the rival within his own camp, stating that a vote for Flávio helps re-elect Lula (Blog do Esmael, July 24), and accused Lula and Flávio of exploiting the crisis with the United States (iG, July 24).
caiado.fracos: He gave back the previous day's gain: he fell 0.30pp, to 1.75%, and retreated 0.50pp in third place in the first round, to 16.00%. The competitive runoff against Lula still lacks confirmation from a second source: Gerp July 22 puts Lula ahead (44x41), not the tie (44x43) from Real Time, and that same Gerp returns him to 3% in the first round. He measures 3-7% of declared vote and is worth 1.75% in the winner book.

haddad.label: HADDAD ([PT](/en/glossary#pt)), presidential Poly 0.35% (flat, vol USD 6.33M) | not tested in the presidential race by the national polls | focus on the São Paulo governorship | running mate Márcio França ([PSB](/en/glossary#psb))
haddad.fortes: Haddad remains the [PT](/en/glossary#pt)'s main figure in the country's largest electorate, with Márcio França ([PSB](/en/glossary#psb)) as running mate on the ticket for the São Paulo governorship. He is the party's reserve name after Lula, although the market does not price a presidential candidacy for him.
haddad.fracos: The market does not price a presidential candidacy for him, and no national poll tests him for that office. He stayed flat at 0.35% on the day Lula rose 1.00pp, which shows the market does not treat his price as derived from the [PT](/en/glossary#pt)'s performance. The focus is at state level: in São Paulo, [Datafolha](/en/glossary#datafolha) July 5 gave Tarcísio 46% x Haddad 30% for the governorship, with Haddad carrying the highest rejection in the state (47%), and the institute released a new São Paulo round on July 24, outside the scope of this national panel.

zema.label: ZEMA ([Novo](/en/glossary#novo)), presidential Poly 0.95% (up 0.50pp, vol USD 4.52M) | Gerp July 22 R1 3% and runoff Lula 44% x Zema 38% | Indexa July 21 R1 3% | no running mate announced, and Michelle ruled out the slot
zema.fortes: He more than doubled in price on the day, from 0.45% to 0.95%, the largest relative variation in the presidential book, and was the only one in the field to rise. He marks 3% consistently in the recent polls (Gerp and Indexa), plus 3.7% at Futura/Apex July 14 and 4% at BTG/[Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) July 13. He defends an agenda of privatizing Petrobras and Banco do Brasil in a possible administration (Jornal do Brasil), a position that sets him apart in the field.
zema.fracos: The rise has no new poll behind it, so it is a market movement and not one of declared vote, in a name that still measures 3% in polling. He loses the runoff to Lula 38x44 at Gerp. Michelle Bolsonaro publicly ruled out being his running mate, and the ticket remains without one as conventions run until August 5.

candidates.analise: The field did not move together today, and the only one that rose was the one that had stayed flat yesterday. Zema more than doubled, from 0.45% to 0.95%, the largest relative variation in the presidential book. Caiado gave back the previous day's gain and fell 0.30pp, to 1.75%, also retreating in third place in the first round, to 16.00%. Michelle retreated 0.10pp, to 0.85%, and Haddad stayed flat at 0.35%. No new poll explains any of these movements, so all of it is rotation internal to the market, on a day when price left the alternatives and went to the frontrunner. The contrast with polling remains intact and is the point AFOS insists on recording: the field measures 3-7% of declared vote in the recent national polls and is worth between 0.35% and 1.75% in the winner market, except Renan, who runs the opposite way and is worth more than he measures. On Caiado's competitive scenario, nothing advanced: Gerp July 22 puts Lula ahead in the head-to-head runoff (44x41), so the tie Real Time indicated (44x43) remains from a single house. What Caiado did today was political, not numerical: he said a vote for Flávio helps re-elect Lula (Blog do Esmael) and accused the two of exploiting the tariff crisis (iG). The conventions, which run until August 5, are the structural test for the field, and they arrive with Zema still without a running mate after Michelle ruled out the possibility.
